result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but one visual defect stands out: in the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner overlaying the center of the restaurant image, indicating the image (or a video/play control) failed to finish loading while sibling cards render fully. Other observations are minor cosmetic notes. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected behaviors and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' displays a white circular loading spinner stuck in the center of the restaurant image, suggesting the image/media never finished loading or a loading state was never cleared, while the rest of the card (title, rating, meta) is fully rendered.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads completely and remove the spinner once loading completes; add a timeout/fallback so a placeholder or the loaded image is shown instead of an indefinite spinner.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a partially visible empty grey chip at the right edge (after 'Healthy'), which reads as an unfinished element rather than intentional scroll affordance because no label is visible on it.
issues.suggestion: Verify the next chip (e.g. another category label) renders its text within the visible sliver, or add edge fade/masking so partially visible chips clearly indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The promotional banner text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a medium green background with decorative lighter circles, which may fall near minimum contrast thresholds for smaller text.
issues.suggestion: Confirm the subheading meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against all parts of the banner background, or darken the banner green / increase text weight.
